==== 1. HNL  ‹§1hnl›

NB: Only teams placed 1st to 3rd, that have a valid licence for the Croatian league may be promoted
      to the Croatian league in the next season.
    Only teams placed 1st to 6th, that have a valid licence for the Croatian league may replace the
      team from Croatian league if that team was placed 1st to 9th and its licence has been revoked.
    Only teams placed 11th or better, that have a valid licence for the First league may participate
      in the First league in the next season.
    Only teams that have a valid licence for the Second league, if relegated, may participate in the
      Second league.
    Licence for Croatian league: Vukovar 1991, Opatija and Rudeš Zagreb.
    Licence for the First league: All except Zrinski Osječko 1664 Osijek.
